findings.evidence: Lines 107–119 state laws solely about CliffordAlgebra.basis and derive them from basis_mul_basis, without using monomialGroup.
findings.fix: Move both results to OrthogonalBasis.lean and export them publicly; keep coefficient bookkeeping private.
findings.issue: The private declarations basis_mul_basis_eq_or and basis_mul_self_eq_or hide reusable multiplication and square laws needed independently of monomialGroup.

findings.evidence: Declarations at lines 92 and 97 rewrite basis Q b ∅ to 1 and basis Q b {i} to ι Q (b i); neither carries a simplification annotation.
findings.fix: Annotate both basis_empty and basis_singleton with @[simp].
findings.issue: basis_empty and basis_singleton lack @[simp], so simplification cannot reduce these basic basis vectors to their characteristic normal forms.

summary: The API hides reusable orthogonal-basis results and omits simplification annotations on characteristic normal forms.
